message: Reopened Predictive Survival after real-world reports that crystals, anchors, and other near-instant lethal sources can kill before protection becomes authoritative even though previous cooperative-detontation GameTests were green.

data.root_cause_direction: existing instant-explosion GameTests wait indefinitely for protection before detonating and therefore do not model first-possible adversarial detonation timing
data.strategy: separate exact fuse/wind-up deadlines from first-observable adversarial burst, reproduce with RED runtime tests, then implement proactive burst guarding only where the client has source-backed pre-impact observability
